Historical full-card image of [[Establish Secret Base (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original)|Establish Secret Base]], matching the [[Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
